Main.dc.html.title: Palette and open questions (Q1, Q3, Q4, Q5)

q2.text:
Q2: Fallback theme
When the browser reports no prefers-color-scheme, fall back to LIGHT instead of dark (Cocos's brand is light).
Order: stored ccs.theme → prefers-color-scheme → light.
Recommended: yes.

q7.text:
Q7: Branding
Borrow the palette only. No Cocos logo, wordmark, name or imagery, so the app doesn't pass itself off as their product.
Recommended: yes.

tweaks.text: The two app previews have Tweaks: switch theme (light/dark) and font (Plus Jakarta Sans / system) to compare.
